decisions.reason: The multi-model garage door operator line remains tightly connected to the firm's core garage-door systems, installer network and service know-how, so its existing knowledge base supports continued improvement and commercialization.

The solid wood sectional garage door is a niche offer that draws less on the firm's main metal-processing and scalable manufacturing capabilities, so learning and improvement benefits are weaker than for core lines.

A separate garage door operator with remote control is likely to be absorbed into the broader operator range as a standard feature, making this distinct product harder to justify as a standalone line.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits the firm's strengths in industrial applications, thermal performance, compliance and customized system selling, giving it strong absorptive-capacity support.

This glazed industrial sectional door still builds on the firm's core industrial door architecture and customer relationships, although overlap with nearby variants creates some ongoing portfolio-rationalization risk.
